title: Labelling the shelves so prices read right
target: How to use price tags and compartments in TCG Card Shop Simulator so what is on a shelf and what it costs are both readable.
version: no version stated by this build (see the sources page)
prerequisites: A shelf or box with stock in it
Cards if you are labelling card shelves

steps.do: Expect the right tag for the container rather than one tag everywhere.
steps.because: price tags are spawned from a set of prefabs, with a separate one for an item box, a package box, a warehouse rack and a card (PriceTagUISpawner, m_UIPriceTagItemBoxPrefab, m_UIPriceTagPackageBoxPrefab, m_UIPriceTagWarehouseRackPrefab, m_UIPriceTagCardPrefab)

steps.do: Know that a shelf gets a group of world interface elements, not one tag.
steps.because: a shelf takes a group prefab of its own (m_Shelf_WorldUIGrpPrefab)

steps.do: Read the price panel's own lines instead of the tag alone.
steps.because: the panel carries the item image, its name, the total and a line for how the price changed (CheckPricePanelUI, m_ItemImage, m_NameText, m_TotalPriceText, m_PriceChangeText)

steps.do: Use the three arrows rather than guessing a trend.
steps.because: the panel has separate arrows for a price going up, going down and not changing (m_UpArrow, m_DownArrow, m_NoChangeArrow)

steps.do: Remember the tag's characters come from an atlas with a cell for each digit and currency mark.
steps.because: the map holds an index for each digit, for a period, a comma, a minus and a space, and for the dollar, euro, yen, pound and cent marks (PriceTagAtlasMap, digitIndex, periodIndex, commaIndex, minusIndex, spaceIndex, dollarIndex, euroIndex, yenIndex, poundIndex, centIndex)

steps.do: Check that the compartment will accept what you are putting in it.
steps.because: a compartment records what it will accept and whether its label can be locked (m_CanPutItem, m_CanPutBox, m_ItemNotForSale, m_CanLockItemLabel)

steps.do: Leave room for a tall item if the compartment grows upward.
steps.because: a compartment has a recorded size and can be affected by a tall item or able to grow upward (m_SizeX, m_SizeY, m_SizeZ, m_AffectedByTallItem, m_HeightGoesUp)

steps.do: For cards, use the placement the compartment offers for graded and ungraded cards.
steps.because: a card compartment has places to put a card, including an alternative for one that has not been graded (m_PutCardLocation, m_PutCardLocationAlt, m_NoneGradedCardUseAltCardLocation)

commonMistakes: Labelling a box with the same tag you use on a rack.
Reading a price without looking at the change line beside it.
Forcing stock into a compartment that was never meant to take it.
Filling a compartment to the top and then adding something tall.
sources: A local copy of the game, read only. Grounding for each step is on the technical reference pages; no number is estimated.
